name: How much does it cost to upgrade laundry room safety features?

mainEntity.name: How much does it cost to upgrade laundry room safety features?

acceptedAnswer.text: The cost of laundry room safety upgrades varies depending on the scope of work. Simple upgrades like installing a lint trap alarm or GFCI outlets might be a few hundred dollars. More extensive projects, such as rerouting dryer vents, upgrading electrical panels, or installing flood sensors, can range from a few hundred to several thousand dollars. We provide detailed estimates after an on-site assessment to give you an accurate cost for your specific needs.
acceptedAnswer.description: Costs vary widely based on the upgrade. Simple fixes are a few hundred dollars; major projects can be several thousand. We provide estimates.
